description:
“Hyun Kim,” agenius exorcist that comes once in a millenia, has always been in love with “Goyeol Choi,” the highly capable and renown amongst the reaper society. Despite multiple romantic attempts, the stoic and desensitized reaper is not prone to react. Hyun devises a plan to rekindle Goyeol's emotions and libido, but the two end up falling into the schemes of dissidents, who aim to conquer the nether... 

At the fork between extinction and resurrection, which path will these two choose?

**Original Webtoon:**   
Chapters: [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/period), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/period_of_selfishness), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5574287)  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1561006307), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/ifcm_0115), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=920019965)
